reason: Driven and reproduced: on a fine pointer at height 844, notes.voice makes documentElement.scrollWidth exceed clientWidth by 145px @320, 75px @390, 35px @430, 5px @460, 0 from 472, and window.scrollX really moves (scrolled to 60 at 390) — and it is user-reached, not URL-only: at 390 fine-pointer the single visible [data-act="voice"] glyph in the dock takes overflow from 0 to 75px on one click. The only relief is `.darkAct kbd { display: none }` inside `@media (pointer: coarse)` (src/notes.css:1787), so a narrowed desktop window — the exact WCAG 1.4.10 reflow test — never gets it; the gate misses it because interaction-check.mjs open() sets isTouch from vp.isMobile and config.viewports starts at 390 with isMobile:true.
sharpenedFix: Ship only the first TWO of the three proposed rules, appended after src/notes.css:1899: `@media (max-width: 720px) { [data-app="notes"] .darkActs { flex: 1 1 100%; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-left: 0; min-width: 0; } }` and `@media (max-width: 720px) { [data-app="notes"] .darkAct { flex: 1 1 100%; min-width: 0; justify-content: center; padding: 0 12px; } }`. Verified with the rules injected at the DOCUMENT TAIL (injecting into <head> loses the same-specificity cascade to the page's own <style> at line 10 and leaves a spurious 26px residual — that, not a second cause, is what the cut-off run saw): overflow is 0px at 320/360/390/430/460/719 in BOTH pointer modes, pills stay 44px tall at 256px @320 and 326px @390, nothing clips, and 768/1440 are unchanged (131/290 fine, 86/215 coarse). Do NOT add the third rule and do NOT delete the coarse keycap hide: without them the keycap still fits unclipped inside the 256px pill at 320 and overflow is still 0, so the Ctrl+Enter hint survives for exactly the keyboard user who narrows a desktop window. Then add { "name": "320x844", "width": 320, "height": 844 } with no isMobile to elevate.config.json so the reflow width is gated on a fine pointer.
